headline: Oil near US$115 after Houthis claim hit on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: Oil near US$115 after Houthis claim hit on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery; Ministers doubt Trump will bend on autos as envoy's warning stings; Bank of Canada hikes to 2.50%, its first increase since 2023.

top.headline: Oil near US$115 after Houthis claim hit on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery
top.what: The Houthis say a ballistic missile struck Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, a fire broke out near the export hub, and Iran has called parts of Qatar's new peace draft unacceptable while saying it welcomes talks.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ministers doubt Trump will bend on autos as envoy's warning stings
top.what: Cabinet ministers told CTV News this is a 'now or maybe never' moment for auto tariffs but doubt Trump will compromise, after Ambassador Pete Hoekstra reportedly said Canada could be blamed for midterm losses.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Bank of Canada hikes to 2.50%, its first increase since 2023
top.what: The Bank of Canada raised its key rate a quarter point to 2.50% on Wednesday, ending seven straight holds and signalling more may come; Premier Doug Ford called the move a massive mistake.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Chow re-elected; GTA voters oust mayors in Mississauga, Hamilton, Oakville and Milton
top.what: Olivia Chow won a second term as Toronto mayor, and final counts show voters across the region replaced several long-serving incumbents.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: New polls show tight Senate races in Ohio, Texas and South Carolina
top.what: With six days left, Trump rallies in Ohio and Obama campaigns in Atlanta as new polls show Democrats ahead nationally and several Republican-held Senate seats in play.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ontario matches Ottawa's investment tax break a day before fiscal update
top.what: Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy says Ontario will mirror the federal immediate write-off for business investment, worth about $8 billion in relief, ahead of Thursday's fall economic statement.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Joly won't meet Stelco owner's CEO without a plan to restore jobs
top.what: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says she will only meet Cleveland-Cliffs CEO Lourenco Goncalves once the company produces a plan and timeline to bring back laid-off Stelco workers.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade overnight drone strikes as UN panel condemns grid attacks
top.what: Russia fired 88 drones and a missile at Ukraine overnight while Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Tula and Lipetsk regions; a UN commission calls Russia's energy strikes a crime against humanity.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.
